articles.summary: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. , Dec. 30, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bank OZK (the “Bank”) (Nasdaq: OZK) expects to report its fourth quarter and full year 2025 earnings after the market closes on Tuesday, January 20, 2026 . Management’s comments on the fourth quarter and full year 2025 will be released
articles.title: Bank OZK Announces Date for Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call
